verdict.rationale: CrewAI is itself a Python framework/SDK with well-documented core primitives (Agent, Task, Crew, Flow), a CLI for scaffolding/testing/running projects, and integration with native LLM provider SDKs, all installable via pip/uv. Community evidence (HN Show-HN post) confirms real developers building against CrewAI's Python API (knowledge_source params, @after_kickoff decorators), validating hands-on SDK usage beyond vendor docs.
